label: Ontic grounding, local law satisfaction, predictive accuracy, normative entitlement and practical…
term: ontic grounding, local law satisfaction, predictive accuracy, normative entitlement and practical choice
resolution: GroundedTotality is existence of a supplied explanatory-ground relation, weaker than independent ultimate adequacy. Follows describes conditional local dynamics; it does not certify real mechanism/explanation. Accurate is error-free prediction over a stipulated law-and-prefix cell, not epistemic entitlement. Optimal and Safe are payoff relations, not definitions of rationality. Sourcehood and complete-history selection do not automatically provide law knowledge, justified inductive generalization or access to a ground. Goldman proposes historical process warrant with qualifications, not perfect prediction. Humean practical reliance is not a blanket entitlement denial. The ontic-to-epistemic and performance-to-normativity bridges remain OPEN.
